svg.data-projection: Albers equal-area, central meridian 105° E, standard parallels 25° and 47° N
svg.title: Chinese Provinces
svg.desc: Made with Natural Earth · Admin 1 states and provinces, repository release v5.1.2. Public domain — https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/. Hong Kong districts dissolved; source Paracel Islands grouped with Hainan; English names; Albers projection; coordinate rounding; shared-border SVG; simplified thumbnail; small-target circles. 33 province-level divisions: 22 provinces, five autonomous regions, four municipalities, and Hong Kong and Macao. Taiwan is excluded from both geometry and roster. Islands remain in geographic position. Dashed circles enlarge small targets. Boundaries follow Natural Earth’s release conventions. Reference rivers: Natural Earth, public domain, repository release v5.1.2. Lake outline (2022): Sun et al. (2026), Dataset of typical terminal lake and surrounding oasis outlines in arid/semi-arid endorheic basins based on remote sensing data. https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.29899274. CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Converted all 300 lake polygons from WGS84 shapefile to GeoJSON, preserving every coordinate and hole; reversed ring winding to GeoJSON convention. No oasis polygons included. The 2022 outline is a dated snapshot of a variable terminal lake.
